He was also insisting to give us an open box piece despite the fact that we were paying in full for a new one with a gst bill. Their dealing was really skewed. Figured that they don’t have stock for anything but jut depend on other vendors for stock and simply charge a commission on sales. The funny thing is, he tried to sell me a a7Miii with 3 lac shutter count at the price of a new one. Despite the fact we were looking for a new one.
Anyway decided not to deal with them. After wasting 3hours and having been spoke to rudely for all this while.
He packed up our stuff and gave it back to us, except he didn’t pack everything. He whacked some of the accessories ( charging and usb cables). Our mistake that we didn’t check it there. But in our defence, they had created quite a hostile environment for us there once they realised that we’re not buying in black, so much so, that we wanted to leave asap. Later on we went to other stores in the same area only to realise that this place has a reputation of shady business. One of ther boys even followed us to see which store we were entering.

Once home, we followed up with him for 2 days to return our cables. Never got them back. Instead we were threatened with violence. And told not to visit fort area again. These guys are a bunch of goons. But there’s no point arguing and fighting with them.

The worst part is, because of this incident, we have decided not to shop in the fort area for camera gear anymore. Other vendors please take note as this kind of behaviour with customers will not only affect customers but all the stores in the area. Despite the fact that we got more genuinely priced and honest deals (not to mention less expensive) from other shops in the area. We have now decided to shop elsewhere, only to avoid such bad experiences. We’ll
probably be shopping on Amazon for the new camera. It’s sad since fort used to be a hub for creative professionals to buy their gear.
Wish law enforcement was stricter with them. They are clearly scamming a lot of people everyday.
